knowledge_base: Anker eufy 售后长尾问题双语知识库
data_source: 黑客松智能服务赛题资料.xlsx

schema.evidence_required: Decision Ontology 要求的证据类型（订单号/SN/图片/视频/购买凭证）
schema.action_boundary: Action Gateway 允许的动作范围（自动执行/转人工/仅建议）
schema.ontology_slots: Service Ontology 中需要关联的实体

entries.question_en: I bought it and it went on sale. Can I get a price difference refund?
entries.question_cn: 我刚买就降价了，能退差价吗？
synonyms_en: it went on sale after I bought it
can I get a partial refund
entries.action_boundary: 仅建议；符合条件时可由 Action Gateway 自动触发价差补偿
entries.handoff_condition: 渠道规则复杂、用户情绪激动、或价保资格需人工核实时
entries.response_en: Anker offers price protection. If the price drops on the same official channel within a short period after purchase, contact support to apply for a price difference refund. Note: price protection is usually calculated from the order date, not the delivery date. Coupons, cross-store promotions, and subsidized prices are typically not eligible. Please provide your order number and a screenshot of the price drop.
entries.response_cn: 安克提供价格保护服务。购买后短时间内发现同一官方渠道价格下降，可联系客服申请价差补偿。注意：价保通常从下单日期开始计算，而非收货日期；优惠券、跨店满减、百亿补贴等通常不参与价保。请提供订单号和降价截图，我帮您核实。

entries.question_en: How do I track my order?
entries.question_cn: 怎么查物流？订单到哪了？
entries.action_boundary: 可自动查询并返回物流状态；异常时转人工发起查件
entries.handoff_condition: 物流超过9天无更新、显示签收但未收到、包裹退回时
entries.response_en: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a 'Track Order Status' link. You can also visit the Anker Order Tracker page. If tracking hasn't updated for 9+ days, or shows delivered but you haven't received it, contact support to initiate an investigation.
entries.response_cn: 订单发货后，您会收到确认邮件，点击邮件中的 Track Order Status 即可追踪物流。也可访问安克官网 Order Tracker 页面查询。如物流超过9天无更新，或显示签收但未收到，请联系客服发起查件。

entries.question_en: How does the national subsidy work? Can I get an invoice?
entries.question_cn: 国家补贴怎么用？补贴商品能开发票吗？
synonyms_en: can I get a company invoice for subsidized product
entries.action_boundary: 仅建议；涉及开票承诺时必须转人工确认
entries.handoff_condition: 涉及开票承诺、售后归属、补贴资格争议时
entries.response_en: Some Anker products participate in the national subsidy program. Subsidies are region-limited — the delivery address must be within the subsidy area. Invoice policy for subsidized products may differ from regular products. We strongly recommend confirming invoice capabilities with support before placing your order. Subsidized products may not participate in nationwide warranty.
entries.response_cn: 安克部分产品参与国家补贴活动。补贴通常限地区，下单时收货地址需在补贴范围内。补贴商品的开票政策可能与其他商品不同，建议下单前务必向客服确认开票事宜。补贴频道商品可能不参与品牌全国联保，售后可能需联系店铺而非安克官方。

entries.question_en: How do I download my invoice?
entries.question_cn: 怎么下载发票？发票抬头写错了能改吗？
entries.action_boundary: 可自动指引下载路径；发票修改需转人工
entries.handoff_condition: 涉及发票抬头修改、公司发票、税号问题时
entries.response_en: Visit the Anker Service Center, find the 'Invoice Download' section, and enter your order information to download the electronic invoice. For invoice corrections, company invoices, or tax ID issues, please contact support for manual processing.
entries.response_cn: 可访问安克服务支持中心，在 Invoice Download 区域输入订单信息下载电子发票。发票信息修改、公司发票、税号等复杂问题请联系客服人工处理。

entries.question_en: My wireless charger isn't working / adapter not charging
entries.question_cn: 无线充电器充不上电/适配器不工作
entries.action_boundary: 可自动执行排查步骤；保修换货需 Action Gateway 核验
entries.handoff_condition: 排查后仍无法解决、需保修换货时
entries.response_en: 1. Check power adapter wattage — wireless charging stations need 18W+ input. 2. Use the included USB-C adapter and cable. 3. Remove phone case if MagSafe incompatible. 4. If indicator blinks, check for insufficient power or foreign object detection. 5. If overheating, move to a ventilated area. If issues persist, warranty replacement may be available.
entries.response_cn: 1. 检查电源适配器功率——无线充电站需18W以上输入。2. 使用附带的USB-C适配器和线缆。3. 如手机壳MagSafe不兼容请取下。4. 指示灯闪烁通常表示供电不足或异物检测触发。5. 过热时移至通风处冷却。如仍无法解决，可申请保修换货。

entries.question_en: I ordered the robot vacuum but only received the replacement parts kit. Where is the main unit?
entries.question_cn: 我买了扫地机器人，只收到配件包，主机去哪了？
entries.action_boundary: 可自动查询拆单状态并告知；丢失需转人工发起调查
entries.handoff_condition: 主机包裹显示已签收但实际未收到时
entries.response_en: Your order was split into 2 packages: Parts kit tracking (delivered) and Main unit tracking (separate). If the main unit still hasn't arrived after the estimated delivery date, I'll launch an internal investigation immediately. Please confirm your order number and provide a photo of the received package.
entries.response_cn: 我查到您的订单拆分为2个包裹发出：配件包单号（已签收），主机包裹单号（单独发货）。如主机仍未收到，我立即为您启动内部核查。请确认订单号并提供收到的包裹照片。
entries.source: 客诉工单信息.xlsx — Anker001 / Anker002 / Anker008

entries.question_en: Tracking number isn't working. Do you know when I'll get my order?
entries.question_cn: 物流单号查不到，什么时候能到？
entries.action_boundary: 可自动解释并查询；超时后转人工发起承运商查询
entries.handoff_condition: 标签创建后超过3个工作日无更新时
entries.response_en: 'Label Created' means the carrier has received shipping info. Physical pickup usually takes 1-2 business days. If there's no update after 3 business days, I'll initiate a carrier inquiry. Please provide your order number.
entries.response_cn: 标签创建（Label Created）表示承运商已收到发货信息，实物揽收通常需要1-2个工作日。如超3个工作日仍无更新，我为您发起承运商查询。请提供订单号。
entries.source: 客诉工单信息.xlsx — 用户未提供订单号 / Anker005

entries.question_en: I haven't received my order yet. When will it arrive?
entries.question_cn: 还没收到货，什么时候能到？
entries.action_boundary: 可自动查询并回复预计时间；超时后转人工
entries.handoff_condition: 超过预计送达日期仍未收到时
entries.response_en: I'll check your order status right away. Please provide your order number. If the estimated delivery date has passed, I'll launch a carrier inquiry immediately — typically 1-2 business days for feedback.
entries.response_cn: 我立即为您查询订单状态，请提供订单号。如已过预计到达时间，我马上发起物流查询，通常1-2个工作日有反馈。
entries.source: 客诉工单信息.xlsx — Anker003 / Anker004 / Anker007 / Anker009

entries.question_en: EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water
entries.question_cn: EB1L：机器人添加清水时遇到错误，任务结束
entries.action_boundary: 硬件故障，保修期内可由 Action Gateway 触发换货流程
entries.handoff_condition: 需确认SN和保修状态后安排换货
entries.response_en: EB1L indicates a clean water adding error on the base station. This is typically a hardware issue. If under warranty, we'll arrange a replacement. Please provide your product SN and a screenshot of the error.
entries.response_cn: EB1L 表示基站添加清水时遇到错误，通常属于硬件问题。如在保，我们为您安排换新。请提供产品SN和错误截图。
entries.source: 客诉工单信息.xlsx — S1 Pro 工单

entries.action_boundary: 硬件故障，保修期内可由 Action Gateway 触发换货流程
entries.handoff_condition: 需确认SN和保修状态后安排换货
entries.response_en: E41 indicates a battery abnormality. Please try restarting the robot first. If the error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll arrange a replacement.
entries.response_cn: E41 表示电池异常。请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可安排换新。
entries.source: 客诉工单信息.xlsx — S1 Pro 工单
